record.issue_text: packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:76 — Attendee de-duplication is case-sensitive and guests input is not deduplicated, so the same address can be added repeatedly to spam or bloat a booking.

adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `uniqueGuests` is computed with `guests.filter(...)` comparing `guest === attendee.email` and checking `blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)` without normalizing case, so `Test@x.com` vs `test@x.com` won’t be treated as duplicates. Additionally, the server-side schema (`addGuests.schema.ts`) does not enforce uniqueness and the handler never deduplicates `guests` itself, so a caller can submit duplicate addresses in `guests` and they will all be passed to `createMany`, potentially creating repeated attendee rows (or at minimum causing DB errors) and enabling spam/bloat. Client-side zod refinement exists only in the dialog and is bypassable.
